description: Directed relationship-point changes granted by story demos: two character ids and the point delta in each direction.

ID.technical: FName row key in StoryCharaRelateChangeDataTables (DTM +0x890). StoryDemo.Id_StoryCharaRelateChange lists these ids; consumers skip None before FindRow. The same id is used when filtering changes for a pair and when estimating demo completion counts.

Id_Character_1.simple: First character of the directed pair.
Id_Character_1.technical: FName. On a demo's first clear the accumulated change is written to StudioNestedNameInts_770[Id_Character_1][Id_Character_2]. Detail/reward UI filters changes by exact (or reversed) character pair, and the battle-story phase preloads face icons for both ids.

Id_Character_2.simple: Second character of the directed pair.
Id_Character_2.technical: FName. Receives the reverse-direction accumulated change in StudioNestedNameInts_770[Id_Character_2][Id_Character_1]; also used for pair filtering, aggregate change display and face-icon preload.

ChangeValue_1_2.simple: Relation points added from character 1 towards character 2.
ChangeValue_1_2.technical: int32, default 0 in the row constructor. AGameManager::OnStoryDemoFirstClear adds it to the nested save map; WidgetTest_CollectRelationshipChanges sums it into the directed Change1/Change2 fields shown in the result dialog. The final level is recomputed by WidgetTest_StoryRelationLevel from GraphPair start-level value plus accumulated points. Exported deltas range 5..25.

ChangeValue_2_1.simple: Relation points added from character 2 towards character 1.
ChangeValue_2_1.technical: int32, default 0 in the row constructor; same accumulation/aggregate-display path as ChangeValue_1_2 in the opposite direction. Exported deltas range 5..50, so relationships are not necessarily symmetric.

notes: Accumulation happens once per demo on first clear; repeated clears do not add again in AGameManager::OnStoryDemoFirstClear (Source/Abrams/Private/GameManagerGraphics.cpp:448-489).

WidgetTest_CollectRelationshipChanges handles reversed row orientation when summing, so a row stored as (B,A) still contributes to the correct displayed direction (Source/Abrams/Private/GamePhase_WidgetTest.cpp:380-387).
143 exported rows; no numbered shards or locale variants were found. Levels themselves come from GlobalThreshold rows, not from this table.

Evidence is from the reconstructed C++ in Source/ (row shape/counts from the exported table); status/ records byte matches for some owner TUs, but this file does not claim a retail byte comparison for every function or exhaustive Blueprint/runtime coverage.

usages.detail: OnStoryDemoFirstClear applies each listed change in both directions to the save data.
Aggregates directed changes for the relationship-change result dialog.
Shows the aggregated changes when a story demo is first cleared (winner team 0).
Filters changes by the selected pair to list their relation-changing demos.
Story_IsCharaRelateNew uses the pair's change ids to detect unfinished/new relation demos.
Preloads face icons for characters affected by the demo's relation changes.
Counts non-None relation changes in the story-completion percentage.
